decisions.reason: Identifies PID 42432 dsh web host as the koffi.node loader, explains the image mapping stays until process exit so npm's copy/unlink fails with EBUSY (§1.2–1.3).
§1.4 explains a refresh only reloads the SPA against the same host; §1.6/§3 give the ordered stop → verify → install → verify version → restart procedure without killing unrelated Node processes.
§2 explains a bare spec follows latest = 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha = 0.1.2-alpha.5, and that npm installs exactly what the tag says, silently downgrading the installed version.

§3 gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus the TUI (combined or separate) after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version = alpha.5, then restarts; @alpha only as a noted mutable alternative.
§4 tells authors to pin the exact tested core version in any plugin install command, avoid unpinned latest drift, pin the plugin too, and document the stop/verify sequence.
